roadmap.title: Survive the Skalitz prologue
roadmap.description: Complete the opening quests, save Theresa during Run!, get jailed in Skalitz before the raid, and enlist with Sir Radzig in Rattay.

roadmap.title: Start the story in Rattay and plan the long run
roadmap.description: Handle the early main quests and side quests around Rattay and Uzhitz, begin the no-kill and celibate approach, and avoid letting quests expire.

roadmap.title: Clear the mid-game story and missable side quests
roadmap.description: Progress the main story through Merhojed, the monastery and Sasau, finish the missable side quests, rebuild Pribyslavitz while illiterate, and start the Rattay tournaments.

roadmap.title: Finish the endgame story
roadmap.description: Complete the final main quests, clear every Siege objective, and reach the Epilogue.

roadmap.title: Complete The Amorous Adventures of Bold Sir Hans Capon
roadmap.description: Track down Capon's necklace, run the charlatan's scares, and settle the burial of Lev.

roadmap.title: Complete Band of Bastards
roadmap.description: Ride with Sir Kuno's company through all five missions and the Ring of Bacchus prank.

roadmap.title: Complete A Woman's Lot
roadmap.description: Live through Theresa's Skalitz story and defend Johanka during the Sasau heresy trial.

roadmap.title: Finish free-roam achievements and collectibles
roadmap.description: Mop up cumulative counters, combat tasks, books, dice games, herbs, shrines and the map.

roadmap.title: Finish the Hardcore Mode playthrough
roadmap.description: Start a new Hardcore save, pick every negative perk for the hardest version, and complete the story again.

achievements.description: Become addicted to alcohol.
achievements.summary: Drink until Henry becomes addicted to alcohol.

steps.text: Buy or steal 30–40 bottles of beer, wine, or spirits.
Drink until Nourishment reaches its maximum, wait 24 hours without eating, then drink again; repeat until the addiction status appears.

achievements.description: Don't sleep for two days and nights.
achievements.summary: Stay awake for two full days and nights.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Wait} function to skip 48 hours without sleeping in any bed.

achievements.description: Be stuffed to bursting for two days.
achievements.summary: Keep Nourishment above 100 for two days.

steps.text: Skip time in 8-hour blocks with @mechanic{Wait} and eat back up to Nourishment 120 between blocks.

achievements.description: Starve for three days.
achievements.summary: Let Henry starve for three days in a row.

steps.text: Eat nothing and use @mechanic{Wait} to pass 72 hours with the hunger status active.

achievements.description: Read twenty books.
achievements.summary: Read a total of twenty books.

guide.context: Reading must be learned first: the Rattay Bailiff points Henry to the scribe in Uzhitz, which starts @mechanic{Mightier than the Sword}. Learning to read blocks the From the Ashes Trial-and-Error achievement, so leave the lesson until Pribyslavitz is rebuilt if both are wanted.

steps.text: Read every book, scroll, and treasure map Henry finds.
Buy extra books from the Uzhitz scribe until twenty are read.
steps.note: Progress is tracked under Statistics > Craft.

achievements.description: Brew fifteen types of potion
achievements.summary: Brew fifteen different potions at an alchemy bench.

guide.context: Recipes are unlocked through quests and can be bought from scribes and herbalists; an alchemy bench stands in the Sasau Monastery and by the Ledetchko herbalist.

steps.text: Collect fifteen different recipes and their herbs.
Brew each recipe at an alchemy bench, following every step, until fifteen different potions are listed under Statistics > Craft.

achievements.description: Kill twenty enemies by stealth
achievements.summary: Kill twenty enemies with stealth kills.

guide.context: Stealth Kill requires the Stealth Kill perk from Stealth level 5 and a dagger in the inventory. Only hostile enemies count, not guards or civilians.

steps.text: Crouch behind sleeping or unaware enemies at bandit camps and use the stealth kill until twenty kills are recorded under Statistics > Combat.

achievements.description: Bag fifty game animals.
achievements.summary: Kill fifty game animals.

steps.text: Shoot or chase down hares, deer, and boar until fifty animals are killed.
steps.note: Hares in the woods south of Uzhitz and around Talmberg are the quickest targets; looting is not required.

achievements.description: Level up Speech to maximum.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum Speech level of 20.

guide.context: Speech 20 is also required for Level Cap.

steps.text: Exhaust every new dialogue option, win speech checks, and haggle often while questing.
Read the four Speech books when levels are missing: the Rattay innkeeper, the Charlatan in Sasau, a beggar random encounter, and treasure 15.

achievements.description: Be popular in every town and village.
achievements.summary: Reach 80 reputation in every town and village.

guide.context: Reputation is checked in Rattay, Uzhitz, Neuhof, Sasau, Talmberg, Ledetchko, Samopesh, Merhojed, Skalitz, and the Sasau Monastery. The monastery is the only permanently missable one: improve it while Henry lives there during @mechanic{A Needle in a Haystack}, using the @mechanic{Infamous} perk and the @mechanic{In the Cloister} and @mechanic{Libri Prohibiti} side quests. A ruined Skalitz reputation from the prologue also blocks this.

steps.text: Complete side quests in each settlement and avoid crimes, fines, and brawls.
Haggle with traders and pay extra until reputation rises; gains cool down after about ten trades, so rotate between towns.
For Merhojed, save everyone in Pestilence, tip traders to 100, then clear the bandit road event south of the village.

achievements.description: Complete all quests.
achievements.summary: Complete eighty quests.

guide.context: Eighty of the 105 quests are enough; main quests, side quests, and activities all count, and failed quests do not block it. Most side quests close when @mechanic{The Die is Cast} begins.

steps.text: Complete quests and activities as they appear and track the count under Statistics > Quest.

achievements.description: Don't kill anyone during the main quest line except Runt.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story without killing anyone except Runt.

guide.context: Track People and Enemies Killed under Statistics > Combat: they must stay at 0 until Runt, then show 1. Animal kills are ignored. Fists and knock-outs are safe; swords and arrows cause bleeding deaths. This cannot be combined with Serial Killer, Sniper, or Stealth Killer.

steps.text: Fight with fists, blunt knock-outs, or stealth takedowns, and use Speech or money to avoid fights.
In @mechanic{Ginger in a Pickle}, keep the coal-burners in the dark and lie to Ginger about the bandits.
In @mechanic{Baptism of Fire}, hang back and let Sir Robard and Sir Radzig kill the enemies; @enemy{Runt} must still be killed.
In @mechanic{All that Glisters}, spare the mysterious knight and Jezhek; in @mechanic{A Needle in a Haystack}, arrest Pious instead of killing him.
In @mechanic{An Oath is an Oath}, conquer with fists and let allies finish the enemies.

achievements.description: Kill 200 people.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 200 people.

guide.context: Civilians and guards count as people.

steps.text: Clear bandit camps or attack settlements at night until the People Killed counter under Statistics > Combat reaches 200.

achievements.description: Discover all locations on the map.
achievements.summary: Find every location on the map.

guide.context: Entering Vranik warns that active side quests will be terminated, so finish other content first.

steps.text: Reach the fast travel point of every settlement: Skalitz, Rovna, Uzhitz, Merhojed, Talmberg, Samopesh, Rattay, Neuhof, Ledetchko, Sasau and Pribyslavitz, plus Vranik, the Inn in the Glade, and the Sasau Monastery.

achievements.description: Win the Talmberg horse race.
achievements.summary: Win the horse race in the Sport of Kings side quest.

guide.context: The race starts at noon the next day after arranging it and is timed.

steps.text: Talk to Zora in Neuhof, pick "I'm looking for work", deliver the stray horse to the Talmberg stables, and arrange the race with the Stablemaster.
Win the race; cut across fields and forest edges instead of following the roads, then dismount and talk to Sir Divish.

achievements.description: Walk more than 50 Km.
achievements.summary: Walk more than 50 kilometres on foot.

steps.text: Keep travelling on foot during normal play; the distance is tracked under Statistics > General.

achievements.description: Find all wayside shrines and conciliatory crosses.
achievements.summary: Find and interact with 90 wayside shrines, conciliatory crosses, and church art objects.

guide.context: Any 90 of the 114 objects count: 42 crosses, 56 shrines, and church art in Sasau, Uzhitz, and Rattay. Objects appear on the map when Henry rides close, but only interacting counts.

steps.text: Ride along every road, including forest paths, and read each shrine, cross, and mural until 90 are recorded.

achievements.description: Steal things with a total value of 30,000 Groschen.
achievements.summary: Steal items worth a total of 30,000 Groschen.

guide.context: Stolen value counts when goods enter the inventory, including poached meat and hides. Selling is not required.

steps.text: Rob weapon and armour shops and Talmberg castle, pickpocket sleeping people, and lockpick chests until 30,000 Groschen of stolen value is recorded under Statistics > Crime.

achievements.description: Reach maximum level.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum main level of 20.

guide.context: Main level is the average of Strength, Agility, Vitality, and Speech, so all four stats must reach 20.

steps.text: Finish the story and side quests, then train the missing stats: combat practice with Captain Bernard, archery and hunting, haggling, and dialogue.

achievements.description: Carry out 100 combos in combat.
achievements.summary: Perform 100 combos in combat.

guide.context: Combos are learned from Captain Bernard at the Rattay combat arena and need the matching weapon equipped.

steps.text: Perform any learned three-hit combo during training with Captain Bernard or against enemies until 100 combos are recorded under Statistics > Combat.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with headshots.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with bow headshots.

guide.context: Guards do not count. Headshots are not always instant kills, so use a strong bow and quality arrows. On PC, wh_pl_showfirecursor 1 restores the bow crosshair and wh_pl_showfirecursor 0 hides it again.

steps.text: Let enemies charge and shoot their heads at close range, or ambush bandit camps at night, until 50 headshot kills are recorded under Statistics > Combat.

achievements.description: Save 2000 Groschen by haggling.
achievements.summary: Save 2,000 Groschen by haggling.

guide.context: Savings count on both purchases and sales.

steps.text: Haggle on every trade; ask for more when selling and pay less when buying until the counter under Statistics > Dialogue reaches 2,000.

achievements.description: Hoard 5,000 Groschen.
achievements.summary: Hold 5,000 Groschen at one time.

steps.text: Sell loot and clear treasure sites until the purse holds 5,000 Groschen at once.

achievements.description: Spend three days in prison.
achievements.summary: Spend three days in prison.

guide.context: Sentences can be split across several arrests.

steps.text: Commit a crime, surrender to the guards, and accept jail time until three days have been served.

achievements.description: Collect 10,000 herbs.
achievements.summary: Collect 10,000 herbs.

steps.text: Pick every herb in dense meadows, such as the fields around the Sasau Monastery; herbalism raises the yield per pick until 10,000 are collected.

achievements.description: Win 1,000 Groschen in the dice minigame.
achievements.summary: Win a total of 1,000 Groschen playing the dice minigame.

guide.context: Dice players sit at inn tables mostly between 18:00 and 22:00; loaded dice and the Perfect Throw Agility perk improve the odds.

steps.text: At the northern Sasau inn, bet the maximum and immediately forfeit ten matches so the opponent holds 1,000 Groschen.
Win it back with maximum bets; if nobody is at the table, wait a day or load an older save.

achievements.description: Complete the opening quest in Skalitz.
achievements.summary: Complete the first main quest, Unexpected Visit.

steps.text: Complete Unexpected Visit.

achievements.description: Rescue Theresa during the Cumans' raid on Skalitz.
achievements.summary: Rescue Theresa from the Cumans in the Run! quest.

guide.context: Missable within the prologue: riding straight to the horse ends the chance.

steps.text: Near the mill on the escape route, distract the three Cumans attacking Theresa by whistling or shoving them, then continue to the horse.

achievements.description: Join Sir Radzig's garrison in Rattay.
achievements.summary: Complete the Awakening main quest.

steps.text: Complete Awakening.

achievements.description: Rescue Lord Capon from the Cumans.
achievements.summary: Save Lord Capon from the Cumans during The Prey.

steps.text: Complete The Prey.

achievements.description: Rescue Ginger from the bandits.
achievements.summary: Save Ginger from the bandits in Ginger in a Pickle.

guide.context: This is exclusive with Merciful: lying to the charcoal-burners keeps Merciful but skips this achievement.

steps.text: At the third coal-burner camp, agree to kill the bandits instead of lying, then clear their forest camp.
Return for Ginger's location, tell him "Just go there and see what happens", report to Sir Radzig at Neuhof, wait 24 hours, and talk to Ginger in Neuhof.

achievements.description: Defeat Runt at the bandit camp.
achievements.summary: Kill Runt during Baptism of Fire.

guide.context: The kill is allowed for Merciful.

steps.text: Kill Runt during Baptism of Fire; use piercing arrows and keep the building's wooden beam between you and him.

achievements.description: Become a monk.
achievements.summary: Join the Sasau Monastery as a novice monk.

guide.context: Henry must know how to read before the monastery chapter.

steps.text: At the inn below the monastery, steal Karl's entry permit from the last room on the first floor at night.
Present yourself at the gate as Karl; leave valuables and stolen goods behind before entering.

achievements.description: Learn the identity of Henry's real father.
achievements.summary: Complete The Die is Cast and learn who Henry's real father is.

steps.text: Complete The Die is Cast.

achievements.description: Conquer the enemy camp in Vranik.
achievements.summary: Complete Payback and conquer the enemy camp at Vranik.

steps.text: Complete Payback.

achievements.description: Complete all optional objectives in the Siege quest.
achievements.summary: Complete every optional objective during the Siege main quest.

guide.context: Failing the side quest In God's Hands at the Sasau Monastery blocks the physician objective, so leave it until the Siege.

steps.text: Before talking to Master Feyfar, ask Sir Robard, Sir Bernard, the Quartermaster, and Sir Divish what they need.
Deliver the charcoal-burner pitch, Andrew's beer from the Inn in the Glade, 30 meat, the fatigue potion, Brother Nicodemus, and a priest.
steps.note: The fatigue potion needs 60 mint, 30 valerian, and 6 wormwood, gathered and delivered to the Samopesh or Ledetchko herbalist over two visits.

achievements.description: Complete the main story line.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story through the Epilogue.

steps.text: Complete the Epilogue main quest.

achievements.description: Get jailed in Skalitz.
achievements.summary: Get jailed in Skalitz during the prologue.

guide.context: Must be done before starting Run!; it cannot be earned afterwards.

steps.text: Steal from a market stall or attack a villager where guards can see it, surrender, and accept jail time.

achievements.description: Get drunk with Father Godwin.
achievements.summary: Get drunk with Father Godwin during Mysterious Ways.

guide.context: This forfeits Virgin, and picking the lower dialogue options at the tavern misses the achievement.

steps.text: Meet Father Godwin at the Uzhitz tavern at night, take the top dialogue options, and agree to keep drinking.

achievements.description: Heal all the sick in Merhojed.
achievements.summary: Save every plague victim in Merhojed during Pestilence.

guide.context: The quest is timed and runs at the same time as Questions and Answers. Literacy lets Henry diagnose the disease from Nicodemus's infirmary books; an illiterate Henry must report how far the sickness has spread and every symptom exactly so Nicodemus can diagnose it in time. Speak with Matthias and inspect the afflicted households, or the diagnosis fails and villagers die.

steps.text: Bring a spade, two thistle, one valerian, and one charcoal, and speak with Matthias at the stud farm.
Inspect the sick in Merhojed: Daniel at the grocery, Bedrishka, Old Straw's wife, and Vincent.

Talk to Johanka and Brother Nicodemus at the Sasau Monastery; read the infirmary book to identify poisoning from water, or report that about half the houses are sick and all the animals died, with fever, stomach pains, diarrhoea and thirst.
Gather ingredients from Nicodemus' shelf and garden and brew the remedy from valerian, thistle, and charcoal.
In Merhojed, treat Daniel, Vincent, and Bedrishka, and let Nicodemus and Johanka take the other houses.
Tell Melichar you brought the remedy, then give a dose to the captive bandit.
Wait a day, then speak with Melichar; the achievement arrives once the village recovers.

achievements.description: Romance Theresa.
achievements.summary: Complete Theresa's Courtship side quest.

guide.context: Courtship unlocks during Keeping the Peace, and completing it forfeits Virgin.

steps.text: Speak with the guard Nightingale during Keeping the Peace to start Courtship.
Meet Theresa for the morning walk in good weather, win the tavern fist fight on the second date, and play in the barn on the third.

achievements.description: Win Lady Stephanie's affection.
achievements.summary: Complete At Your Service, My Lady and win Lady Stephanie's affection.

guide.context: Lady Stephanie waits on the upper floor of Talmberg castle and can be visited after the prologue, not during the first story visit. Accepting her shirt forfeits Virgin.

steps.text: Complete her three tasks: bring back the horse (ask the stable boy for the song), recover the crown from the ambushed merchant's trail and chest, and get the wine (win the contest, pay about 150 Groschen, or pass a Speech check).
Return to Lady Stephanie and pick "Alright" when she offers the shirt to court her.

achievements.description: Sell out Fritz and Matthew during the Gallows Brothers quest.
achievements.summary: Betray Fritz and Matthew during the Gallows Brothers quest.

guide.context: Their questline starts at the Wagonner's Inn near Sasau and the later quests are timed. Selling them out blocks Friends without Benefits.

steps.text: Advance their questline through the heist quest A Rock and a Hard Place, stealing the miners' gold from the chest locked in the southern Talmberg tower.
Leave the empty sack on the barrel in Andrew's cellar, then tell Sir Robard that Andrew, Fritz and Matthew were behind the robbery.
Return to the Inn in the Glade and interact with the pair at the entrance.

achievements.description: Get Erik to reveal his past.
achievements.summary: Pass all four persuasion checks when interrogating Erik during Family Values.

guide.context: Erik's stats scale with Henry's Rattay reputation; lowering it toward 70 and saving before the interrogation makes the four checks passable. A Speech of about 12 or Bard potions help.

steps.text: During Family Values, interrogate Erik and ask who this Toth is, how he met him, what they are after, and how many men hold the castle.

achievements.description: Earn the title of Talmberg's Master Huntsman.
achievements.summary: Become the Talmberg Master Huntsman by backing Hanekin Hare.

guide.context: Joining the poachers cancels Hare Hunt, so side with Hanekin Hare and keep him alive.

steps.text: Talk to Andrew at the Inn in the Glade, then to the Talmberg huntsman Nicholas Angel, to start Hare Hunt.
Ask Andrew to join the poachers for Sheep in Wolf's Clothing, win proof of skill at their tournament, and side with Hanekin Hare.
Complete Cherchez la Femme by abducting Margaret and making Nicholas sign the papers, then tell Sir Divish you want to be the new huntsman.

achievements.description: Complete the Robber Baron side quest.
achievements.summary: Complete the Robber Baron side quest from Sir Hans Capon.

guide.context: Unlocked after The Prey and Next to Godliness. Calling in Sir Bernard's attack is an alternative to the negotiation route.

steps.text: Talk to Sir Hans after Next to Godliness, wear the clothes he provides until the meeting with Sir Hanush, and follow Bernard's riders to the camp.

Scout the camp: count roughly ten bandits for Bernard, or negotiate as a messenger with Speech 15 or Charisma 17, the coat of arms worn, weapons stowed, asking for his side and answering "You have no quarrel with Hanush".
Report back through Sir Bernard to Sir Hanush to finish the quest.

achievements.description: Sabotage all three planned executions.
achievements.summary: Sabotage all three executions in Money for Old Rope.

guide.context: Requires reading through Mightier than the Sword and the Tough Love side quest, and the quest runs on a timer of about one week. Finish Trial-and-Error's rebuild before learning to read.

steps.text: Talk to the Rattay executioner Herman to start Money for Old Rope, then ask the bailiff's clerk about the three convicts and read the black book on the Rathaus upper floor.
Poison the wagon tongue on the driver's seat at the guest executioner's camp, switch the rope in the barn, and swap the sword from the left tent for one ground down to no durability.
Report to Herman and wait for the execution at two in the afternoon the next day.

achievements.description: Join the witches' dance in Playing with the Devil.
achievements.summary: Join the witches' ritual in Playing with the Devil.

guide.context: The quest comes from Father Godwin in Uzhitz during or after Mysterious Ways; finishing it forfeits Virgin.

steps.text: Ask Father Godwin for work, visit the herbalist in the woods, and question the three women about the stolen ointment.
Follow the women into the woods at night, take part in the ritual, and answer "I will give you anything you ask".
Return to Father Godwin to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Finish the whole story without sleeping with anyone.
achievements.summary: Complete the entire main story as a virgin.

guide.context: Conflicts in practice with Casanova, Sinner, Bad Trip, McLovin and Full House Sinner.

steps.text: Decline Lady Stephanie's shirt and courtship, and stop Theresa's Courtship before the final barn date or skip it entirely.
Refuse to keep drinking with Father Godwin and never buy the bathhouse's full package.

achievements.description: Finish the game in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on Hardcore Mode.

guide.context: Hardcore disables fast travel and the compass, raises damage, lowers rewards and stops quest autosaves; negative perks are chosen at the start. If Amorous Adventures is enabled, its quests may need finishing before the ending.

steps.text: Start a new game, select Hardcore Mode with at least two negative perks, and complete the main story.
Save manually with sleep or Saviour Schnapps, because there are no quest autosaves.

achievements.description: Finish the game in Hardcore Mode with all negative perks.
achievements.summary: Finish Hardcore Mode with all nine negative perks enabled.

guide.context: The nine negative perks are nightmares, claustrophobia, haemophilia, numbskull, somnambulance, shakes, tapeworm, consumption and brittle bones.

steps.text: Start a Hardcore run and enable every negative perk before leaving the opening.
Soften them where possible: Featherweight against brittle bones, Thickblooded against haemophilia, heavy Strength perks for consumption, and a visorless helmet for claustrophobia.
steps.note: Nightmares wear off after about two in-game hours, and sleeping at a bathhouse avoids the debuff; somnambulance means waking far from the bed, so find a landmark before travelling.

achievements.description: Die for the first time on a Hardcore Mode save.
achievements.summary: Die for the first time on a Hardcore Mode save.

steps.text: Start a Hardcore game and die once; any early death is enough.

achievements.description: Ensure the renewal of Pribyslavitz.
achievements.summary: Complete the renewal of Pribyslavitz.

guide.context: Sir Divish offers the bailiff role after Baptism of Fire; bring around 15,000 Groschen so the village does not go bankrupt.

steps.text: Accept the bailiff role and build every plot: woodcutter's camp, road, trader, bakery (grain from Samopesh) or butcher, beehives, tavern, forge, stable or guard tower, Rathaus and church.
Hire specialists as income allows and finish with the church, then speak with Sir Divish for the final title.

achievements.description: Rebuild all of Pribyslavitz while Henry is illiterate.
achievements.summary: Rebuild all of Pribyslavitz while Henry cannot read.

guide.context: Learning to read ends the opportunity, so start the rebuild without taking the reading lesson and finish it before the monastery chapter, which requires literacy.

steps.text: Begin the Pribyslavitz rebuild immediately after Baptism of Fire without learning to read, following the usual build order.
Keep the Rathaus and church for last because they drain money, complete the construction, and speak with Sir Divish.

achievements.description: Make 2,000 Groschen a day from Pribyslavitz.
achievements.summary: Reach an income of 2,000 Groschen per day from Pribyslavitz.

guide.context: Bad judgments or building the church and Rathaus too early can keep income below the target.

steps.text: Build the profitable structures first and hire every specialist: Raspberry, Kunesh, Kornelius, Silvester, Adam, Mirka, Zach for the armoury, Fink for the forge, and Vashek and Marek for the stable.
Settle the judgments in the village's favour and upgrade the tavern, forge and stable until the daily income passes 2,000.

achievements.description: Bring Fritz and Matthew to live in Pribyslavitz.
achievements.summary: Invite Fritz and Matthew to settle in Pribyslavitz.

guide.context: A tavern must be built before they accept, and betraying them for Judas blocks this permanently.

steps.text: Finish their questline without selling them out, then talk to both Fritz and Matthew to invite them to the village.

achievements.description: Get a complete set of armour from the Rattay tourney.
achievements.summary: Collect all five Lords of Leipa armour pieces from the Rattay tournament.

guide.context: The tournament becomes a weekly activity through the Rattay Tourney introduction; the upper castle is decorated the day before each event.

steps.text: Get the Rattay Tourney activity from the Samopesh smith or innkeeper, then enter a tournament at Rattay Upper Castle for 60 Groschen.
Win the best-of-three duels and collect one armour piece from Sir Hanush after each victory; repeat across five tournaments.
steps.note: Pushing and stabbing drain the opponent's stamina, and the Herald can tell you how many rounds the current tournament has before you enter.

achievements.description: Let Capon's rendezvous succeed without winning over the butcher.
achievements.summary: Complete Capon's night rendezvous without persuading the butcher.

guide.context: Both outcomes come from the same scene, so save beforehand if Wingman is also wanted.

steps.text: Deliver the potion and read the book, tell Capon he does not look well and that appearance does not matter, then hide at the rendezvous.
At the timed prompts pick "Gentle night...", "And now my heart in sorrow dwells...", "Ah Lord, let me not wait in vain...", and "Blame it on the French!".
Let the scene with the butcher play out however it goes; Capon still thanks you the next morning.

achievements.description: Make Capon's night out go exactly according to his plan.
achievements.summary: Get Capon's night out to go exactly to plan by winning over the butcher.

guide.context: Both outcomes come from the same scene, so save beforehand if True Friend is also wanted.

steps.text: At the rendezvous pick "Gentle night...", "And now my heart in sorrow dwells...", "Ah Lord, let me not wait in vain...", and "Blame it on the French!".
Pass the persuasion (around 10), charisma (around 14), or intimidation (around 15) check with the butcher.
When Henry runs out of replies, start singing and keep singing through all three prompts.

achievements.description: Win back Capon's heirloom at the camp's dice tournament.
achievements.summary: Win Capon's necklace back at the camp's dice tournament.

guide.context: Exclusive with Lord Capon's Ghost, so save before entering the camp. Loaded dice and Pribyslavitz beer improve the odds.

steps.text: Enter the robber baron camp in noble or plate clothing and answer the guard's test with "Alphonse" and "from Slany" or "from Prague".
Talk to Old Blaha to join the dice tournament and beat the bandits; do not speak to the leader before winning.
steps.note: Losing once still allows a rematch.

achievements.description: Steal Capon's necklace back without asking anyone.
achievements.summary: Steal Capon's necklace from the robber baron camp without permission.

guide.context: Exclusive with I Can Quit Anytime; the storage chest's lock is very hard, so bring lockpicking skill or a potion.

steps.text: Reach the camp's hidden storage through the tunnel from outside or the broken wooden wall inside, avoid the patrolling guard, and open the chest.

achievements.description: Add extra scares of your own to the Ledetchko haunting.
achievements.summary: Add extra scares beyond the charlatan's tasks to finish the Ledetchko haunting.

guide.context: Gather 50 spoiled roe-deer venison, 25 spoiled mutton, 4 spoiled chicken, a spade, St. John's wort, poppy and thistle before starting. Bury Lev's remains before the final scare, because the burial opportunity disappears when the quest ends.

steps.text: Keep the remains and make the fake blood from wine, St. John's wort, poppy and thistle, ground and boiled once.

Complete the four main tasks: swap the hanging meat for spoiled meat (check the chicken outside, then the mutton and locked venison at night), leave charcoal in three egg hatches, steal the rosaries, and pour the blood into a bath tub.
Do the extra scares: pay the itinerants 20 Groschen for the hellfire task, throw a rotten egg into the well, and ask Fritz and Matthew to help if they are around.
Talk Felix into going to the grave, shoot the lantern and bark until he flees, then report to the charlatan after his 10 a.m. check.

achievements.description: Give Lev a Christian burial at the Rattay churchyard.
achievements.summary: Bury Lev's remains at the cross in Rattay's churchyard.

guide.context: Exclusive with Not-so-Christian Burial; save before burying if both are wanted.

steps.text: Keep the bones instead of selling them, then interact with the large stone cross in front of the Rattay church.

achievements.description: Bury Lev beside his family at the charcoal-burners' graves.
achievements.summary: Bury Lev's remains with his wife and child at the charcoal-burners' graves.

guide.context: Exclusive with Christian Burial; save before burying if both are wanted.

steps.text: Keep the bones, then find the town gossip and pass the check to learn where Lev's family is buried.
Look downhill to the right of the charcoal-burner's grave for three large wood carvings and bury the remains there.

achievements.description: Follow the raiders' trail to their hideout.
achievements.summary: Follow the raiders' trail to their hideout in Bad Blood.

guide.context: Missable: when Kuno wants to ride straight to Sir Radzig, tell him the investigation should continue.

steps.text: At the burned farm, search the hovel on the forest side and take the shield and note from the pantry.
Talk to Stephan Fletching in the meadow east toward the Inn in the Glade, then follow the tracks and dropped goods east through the forest; the achievement unlocks at the raiders' clearing.

achievements.description: Convince Kuno to storm the mill immediately.
achievements.summary: Convince Kuno to storm the attacked mill right away in Uninvited Guests.

guide.context: Agreeing to Kuno's plan to wait until the raiders are drunk forfeits the achievement.

steps.text: When the mill girl begs for help at night, use the Speech option (around level 7) or the Charisma option (around level 10) to push Kuno into an immediate attack.

achievements.description: Keep your promise to Jakey.
achievements.summary: Keep your promise to Jakey by letting him go in Thirty Pieces.

guide.context: Exclusive with Torturer. Save with a Saviour Schnapps before talking to Jakey, since the outcomes exclude each other.

steps.text: Follow the trail from the Inn in the Glade to Jakey, hear him out, then pick "I'll untie you" instead of the persuasion option and let him go.
Report back to Sir Kuno; keeping the promise adds an extra option when Hagen's offer is discussed later.

achievements.description: Leave Jakey tied up for a day before he talks.
achievements.summary: Leave Jakey bound for a day before he talks in Thirty Pieces.

guide.context: Exclusive with Pinky Promise; save before speaking to Jakey.

steps.text: Find Jakey and pick "You don't want to talk? Alright.", leave him for a full day, then return and pick "You can go".

achievements.description: Convince Kuno to face Hagen in battle.
achievements.summary: Persuade Kuno to stand and fight Hagen in What Price Honour?.

guide.context: Only the Speech persuasion (around level 7) unlocks it; bribing with 15,000 Groschen or reminding him of his promise does not.

steps.text: At the parley on the hills near Merhojed, choose the persuasion option so Kuno refuses Hagen's offer, then win the battle and report to Sir Radzig.

achievements.description: Finish the Ring of Bacchus game and return the ring to Kuno.
achievements.summary: Finish the Ring of Bacchus game by returning the ring to Sir Kuno.

guide.context: The activity opens after beating Dangler at the camp and talking to The Stone; a couple of hours after each delivery the next challenger calls for Henry.

steps.text: Beat Dangler in a duel or pickpocket him, then deliver the ring to The Stone.
Bring Stephan a Lullaby Potion made from oil, poppy, herb paris and thistle, then shoot the kestrel nest from the partly dead tree for Jan; the hint from Jakey costs 20 Groschen or a Charisma check.
Take the ring from Jan for Petr by pickpocketing or winning the brawl.
Find the ring for Kuno at the east-to-west hay drying pole with the cross-shaped frame, or win it back at dice, and return it to him.

achievements.description: Lose the Ring of Bacchus to a fellow mercenary.
achievements.summary: Lose the Ring of Bacchus overnight at the mercenaries' camp.

guide.context: Do not reload after losing it: the follow-up riddle returns the ring and Game Over remains possible.

steps.text: Keep the ring instead of delivering it, wait until the camp sleeps, and sleep until around seven in the morning.
Read the thief's note, question the mercenaries, and answer The Stone's riddle with "Humility" to get the ring back.

achievements.description: Save every survivor of the Skalitz raid.
achievements.summary: Rescue every survivor during Angel of Mercy in Theresa's story.

guide.context: Five survivors are scattered around the Skalitz area during the aftermath: Holba, Stanislav, Jarmila, Julian and Marosh. Search the countryside and help each one.

steps.text: During the aftermath in the Skalitz area, search the countryside and help every survivor you find.

achievements.description: Give Henry his famous hand wound in a sparring match.
achievements.summary: Finish the sparring match with Henry in Ordinary Routine.

steps.text: Talk to Bianca at the Skalitz tavern for the beer, bring it to Henry at the combat arena, and spar with him through to the cutscene.

achievements.description: Complete Theresa's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Theresa's story and thank her at the end.

guide.context: The story starts at Rattay Mill after Awakening by asking Theresa how she survived.

steps.text: Play through Theresa's whole storyline to the end of the aftermath and talk with her in the final conversation.

achievements.description: Skip every morning chore at the mill.
achievements.summary: Skip every morning chore during Ordinary Routine in Theresa's story.

guide.context: No chore may be completed: feeding the chickens, feeding the dog, weeding the garden, or waking Samuel.

steps.text: Run away from the house as soon as you control Theresa until the chores fail, talk to your father, then run off again until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Recover Pavel's treasure without being discovered.
achievements.summary: Recover Pavel's treasure in Bonum Commune without being spotted by the Cumans.

guide.context: Stealth kills are allowed; only being discovered fails the requirement.

steps.text: Start from the Sasau quarry by the marsh where the stream meets the river, follow the stream and forest path to the abandoned settlement, and examine the body there.
Wait for darkness, sneak past or stealth-kill the three Cumans, take the treasure from the chimney of the far building, then return to the Wagonner's Inn and tell Pavel.

achievements.description: Pass out during the drinking contest with Ambrose.
achievements.summary: Pass out while drinking with Ambrose in Casting Lots.

guide.context: Henry's Drinking skill must be 10 or lower to pass out first; save before drinking and reload after if Angel of Mercy is also planned.

steps.text: At the Sasau Wagonner's Inn pick the strongest options, three kegs, during the binge until the loading screen says "You're unconscious!".

achievements.description: See what Henslin has in his braies without being observed.
achievements.summary: Pickpocket Henslin's powdered unicorn horn in Go, and Sin No More.

guide.context: Requires the Pickpocket skill from Peshek at the Rattay mill, and the bathhouse madam must let Henry into Adela's room.

steps.text: At the Ledetchko bathhouse, convince the madam to unlock Adela's room (Speech around 12, Charisma around 9, or Intimidation around 10) and step inside quietly.
While Henslin fights Adela, sneak and pickpocket the powder from him without being caught.

achievements.description: Have on your conscience every sin Johanka can think of.
achievements.summary: Confess every sin on Johanka's list.

guide.context: Triggers after the argument with the villagers following Bonum Commune. The sins are adultery with Lady Stephanie, a bathmaid, theft, jail time, killing Runt, another murder, and drunkenness, and each must be committed days earlier so the rumors spread. Requires Baptism of Fire and At Your Service, My Lady; conflicts with Virgin and, for the murder, with Merciful. Patch 1.9.7 fixed an unlock bug.

steps.text: Commit every sin well before the scene, then do a few other activities so the rumors have time to spread.
Continue Johanka's questline after Bonum Commune until she lists your sins.

achievements.description: The punishment fits the crime.
achievements.summary: Kill the false guard in Infernal Dream and throw his body into the mineshaft.

steps.text: After Johanka's dream, ride to Skalitz and follow her directions past the ore-washing tanks, the pond and the stone channel to the cave mouth.
Search the mine, the mineshaft by the wooden chimney and the miner's huts, kill the disguised brigand, carry him to the mineshaft, and throw him down.

achievements.description: Defend Johanka against the heresy charge.
achievements.summary: Defend Johanka successfully at her heresy trial.

guide.context: The good ending requires a selfless Madonna of Sasau run: return Ambrose's money, donate Pavel's money in his name, avoid relations with Adela, complete the Uzhitz pilgrimage for Father Godwin's manuscript, and keep Johanka's trust. A three-day timer starts once the Bishop is told.

steps.text: Gather the witnesses: Sir Sebastian, Bailiff Hashek, Father Fabian, Brother Nicodemus, Guta, Adela and Pavel.
Get into the jail through the Bailiff's house yard, persuade Johanka to show humility, then return to Brother Nicodemus.
Ask Matthias in the infirmary for his lucky dice, bring them to Johanka, and persuade her a second time.
Read Matthew of Janow's manuscript and tell the Inquisitor you are ready for the trial.
At the trial in St. Martin's Church call every witness, use the Speech options to intervene, and press the swordsmith's wife about the ruffians.

achievements.description: Report every wrongdoing in the province to the Inquisitor.
achievements.summary: Report all six wrongdoings in the province to the Inquisitor.

guide.context: The six reports need drinking with Father Godwin, Father Simon, the Waldensians, the witches, the devil's skull, and the monks' drinking cellar, so finish any missing quests before speaking to the Bishop, who starts a three-day timer. Drinking with Godwin and joining the witches conflict with Virgin.

steps.text: When the Inquisitor reminds Henry of his Christian duty, report every wrongdoing and give the monk's name Lucas.
